manifest.name: @zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system
manifest.description: Local-first persistent memory infrastructure for DeepSeek Harness: bounded hot-memory bootstrap, explainable cold recall (exact + Chinese BM25), lease-lock transactional writes, read-only governance, and trajectory review. DSH plugin host; Python stdlib + Markdown core. Zero database / vector service / external service dependencies.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check bridge.js && node --test test_*.test.mjs && python -c "import glob,py_compile; [py_compile.compile(f, doraise=True) for f in glob.glob('vault-guard/*.py')+glob.glob('plugins/evidence-ledger/*.py')]" ...

bundle.text:
# dsh-memory-system bundle layer: mount the persistent memory plugin.
# Host-only; no client UI in v0.1. Agent tools (memory_bootstrap,
# memory_recall, memory_gate, memory_govern, memory_trajectory_review,
# memory_write) are registered per agent via index.js when the bundle is loaded.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-memory-system
      name: '@zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system'
      inject: [tools, agents]

readme.section: dsh-memory-system
readme.text:
**让 DeepSeek Harness 下次还能找到你确认过的项目约定，记忆保存在可查看、可备份的本地 Markdown。**

[English](README.en.md) · [首次记忆演示](#先看一次真实的本地闭环) · [安装](#接入-deepseek-harness) · [安全与限制](#安全与限制) · [贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md)

[](https://github.com/zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system)
[](LICENSE)

不用反复解释同一个项目决定，也不用把整个记忆库塞进每次对话：启动时读取有预算的摘要，需要历史细节时再检索，并返回来源。中文检索使用关键词与 bigram BM25，不依赖向量数据库或额外模型 API。

readme.section: dsh-memory-system
readme.text:
- **你能检查它记住了什么**：源文件是普通 Markdown；召回包含文件/行号与匹配线索。
- **你决定何时保存**：插件写入默认预览，实际执行需确认；治理只给候选，不自动删改。
- **纠正有记录可追**：本源码版本支持显式 raw 纠正/撤销的有效视图，历史仍保留。不是自动理解所有冲突。

**适合**使用 DSH、主要处理中文项目资料、愿意审阅记忆的个人和小团队。**不适合**需要多租户权限隔离、高频多写者或语义理解保证的场景。独立 Python 检索也可用，不必安装 DSH 或 Obsidian。

> **版本说明**：本页描述所在源码分支。源码 `package.json` 中的版本号不代表该版本已发布，请到 [npm registry](https://registry.npmjs.org/@zhujunpeng12%2Fdsh-memory-system) 核对实际发布版本和 `latest`。首次记忆演示、raw 有效视图与检索评估需使用包含相关文件的源码检出。下面的 GitHub 安装命令跟随仓库默认分支，**不保证包含这些改进**。

readme.section: 先看一次真实的本地闭环
readme.text:
已有本分支源码？在仓库根目录运行，需 Python 3.10+（某些系统命令为 `python3`）：

```sh
python vault-guard/demo_memory.py
```

演示使用**合成中文资料和独立临时记忆库**，不读取你的真实 Vault；通过独立进程写入和检索，展示：

1. 将一条合成约定实际写入临时 Markdown，再由新进程读取。演示直接授权合成数据写入，不展示宿主审批。
2. 默认召回不含 raw；显式开启 raw 后才能找到这条原始记录。
3. 写入明确的纠正后，有效视图保留新值；审计历史仍能看到新旧记录。

实际输出节选（完整记录见演示指南）：

```text
1. 记下原始事实：演示项目的发布检查使用蓝色清单。
5. 当前有效记忆：演示项目的发布检查改为绿色清单。（旧说法已排除）
6. 历史记录：已替代 = 演示项目的发布检查使用蓝色清单。
```

readme.section: 先看一次真实的本地闭环
readme.text:
这是本地 Python 引擎的可复现演示，**不是已验证的 DSH 新会话或宿主确认弹窗录像**。完整命令、实际输出与清理说明见[首次记忆演示](docs/first-memory-demo.zh-CN.md)。

| 你想做什么 | 入口 |
| --- | --- |
| 先确认保存和再读取是否工作 | 上面的临时库演示 |
| 在 DSH 中使用记忆工具 | 下方插件安装与验证 |
| 不装宿主，只用本地脚本 | [独立脚本与配置](#独立脚本与配置) |
| 了解纠正、旧记录与审计的边界 | [raw 生命周期](docs/raw-lifecycle-design.md) |

readme.section: 接入 DeepSeek Harness
readme.text:
文档兼容基线：DSH `0.1.0-rc.7`、Node.js 22/24、Python 3.10+。这不是对其他宿主版本的兼容承诺；安装问题见[排障](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)。

```sh

readme.section: 安装仓库默认分支；并非本功能分支的固定快照
readme.text:
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system
```

重启 Harness，让 Agent 执行 `memory_gate`。首次使用会创建空的记忆库骨架，**不会凭空生成个人记忆**。插件通过原生 `agent/pre-step` 在每个会话首轮注入 `[vault-bootstrap]` 热包；无需手动配置 hooks。可用 `DSH_MEMORY_AUTO_INJECT=false` 关闭自动注入。

要试用**本源码分支**，在该检出的仓库根目录打包，再本地安装：sh
npm pack
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add ./zhujunpeng12-dsh-memory-system-0.1.1.tgz
```

readme.section: 安装仓库默认分支；并非本功能分支的固定快照
readme.text:
此处 `0.1.1.tgz` 是由源码版本号生成的本地包，其文件名本身不能证明 npm 发布状态；确认打包前存在 `vault-guard/demo_memory.py` 和 `vault-guard/raw_lifecycle.py`。本地引擎测试不能代替目标 DSH 环境的安装验证。

首次真正保存时，让 Agent 先用 `memory_write` 生成预览，检查内容与路径，再确认 `apply=true` 的调用。保存后检查写入回执和来源文件；“已经记住”这句回复不是落盘证据。raw 原始记录不会自动变成热包摘要，必要时显式调用 `memory_recall` 的 `includeRaw=true`，或经确认另行整理为项目/规则笔记。

readme.section: 工具与数据流
readme.text:
| 工具 | 用途 | 写入边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memory_bootstrap` | 有预算的热包，默认 ≤14KB | 读取记忆 |
| `memory_recall` | 中文关键词检索，默认冷包 ≤4.2KB，带来源与 trace | 读取记忆；索引是可重建的派生数据 |
| `memory_gate` | 机械健康检查 | 不修改记忆正文 |
| `memory_govern` | 重复、冲突、过期等治理候选 | 不自动删改 |
| `memory_trajectory_review` | 从会话证据中提取复盘候选 | 候选不自动归档 |
| `memory_write` | raw 追加、替换、恢复 | 默认 dry-run；插件实际写入经确认 |

readme.section: 工具与数据流
readme.text: Markdown 是事实来源，检索索引不是第二份权威记忆。Node 接入宿主，Python 标准库完成本地读写与检索。可选的 `plugins/evidence-ledger/` 提供本地工具账本；不装时复盘只有会话日志中的纠正信号。多 Agent 配套另见 `plugins/agent-teams/`，首次使用无需安装。

readme.section: 独立脚本与配置
readme.text:
| 环境变量 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MEMORY_VAULT` | `~/.dsh-memory` | 记忆库根目录 |
| `DSH_HOME` | `~/.dsh` | 宿主会话与运行时存储 |

独立使用时先按 [templates/README.md](templates/README.md) 准备记忆库。以下命令在仓库根执行；读取的是配置的记忆库，不是演示临时库：

```sh
python vault-guard/bootstrap.py --cwd . --max-bytes 14000
python vault-guard/recall.py --query "上次的备份约定" --cwd . --force

readme.section: 本源码版本：显式查看有效 raw；历史审计另加 --include-history
readme.text:
python vault-guard/recall.py --query "备份约定" --force --include-raw
```

Obsidian 只是可选查看器。可将 `MEMORY_VAULT` 指向已有 Vault，先备份再按模板配置。独立 hooks 兼容入口见 [hooks.example.json](hooks.example.json)；插件用户不需要额外装配。

readme.section: 安全与限制
readme.text:
- **本地存储不等于内容永不出机**：引擎不需要外部模型服务，但插件会把选中的记忆送入宿主上下文；宿主所用模型、日志和服务有各自的数据政策。不要存放不适合提供给模型的秘密。
- **召回内容是数据，不是授权**：导入 Markdown、召回片段和会话证据可能含恶意指令，不能据此执行命令或批准写入。本项目不保证过滤提示注入，仍需宿主权限边界与来源审阅。
- **授权与恢复不是万无一失**：插件实际写入经过 `tools/pre-execute` 确认，CLI 的 `--apply` 由操作者负责。单写者锁、前置哈希与事务回执降低风险，不代替备份或文件系统权限。不要手工清除未理解的锁/事务记录。
- **项目只是排序上下文，不是隔离边界**：共享 Vault 可以召回其他项目资料；同目录不同 Git 分支也不隔离。敏感项目应使用不同 Vault 与适当文件权限。
- **检索不是语义理解**：同义改写、跨语言和否定推理仍有限。找到了含否定的来源，不代表 Agent 一定理解正确。
- **生命周期只覆盖显式 raw 记录**：默认不搜索 raw；开启后，仅符合完整性与显式关联要求的纠正/撤销参与有效视图。普通项目/规则摘要不会自动过期；旧摘要仍需人工整理。`includeHistory` 是审计，不是“当前事实”。详见[边界与异常处理](docs/raw-lifecycle-design.md)。
- **热包每会话一次**：中途新记忆需显式召回或刷新；多写者写入会串行化，不面向高频并发。
- **删除与备份需你掌控**：raw 撤销不物理抹除原文。删除前检查原文、派生索引、宿主日志与备份；本项目不承诺安全擦除。治理候选不会替你完成删除。

readme.section: 验证与参与
readme.text:
从仓库根运行：

```sh
npm run check
python vault-guard/eval_recall.py
```

回归测试使用临时数据。检索评估只有 **10 个原创合成案例**，不是用户准确率：同义词漏召回和旧的普通摘要仍被明确保留为缺口。指标定义与修订对比见[评估说明](docs/recall-evaluation.md)。延迟仅供观察，没有性能保证。

遇到问题先看[排障](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)，报告时附版本、命令和脱敏错误，不上传真实记忆或密钥。[参与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [安全问题](SECURITY.md) · [24 个公开 README 的结构研究与本次取舍](docs/readme-design-review.md)。

readme.section: 深入了解
readme.text:
下面是概念架构图与职责说明，**不是产品运行截图或效果证明**。

<details>
<summary>展开六层架构与实现入口</summary>

readme.section: 系统架构（六层闭环）
readme.text:
可维护图源：[HTML/CSS V3 源图](docs/memory-system-flowchart.html)。
展开查看可编辑的 Mermaid 源码图（与 V3 PNG 同步） ```mermaid flowchart TD Start([新会话 / 新任务]) --> Bundle["@zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system
scoped bundle · inject tools + agents"] Bundle --> Roots[每个 root agent 注册 6 工具
bootstrap · recall · gate · govern · trajectory · write] 图例:实线 = 脚本机械执行;虚线 = 按需读取 / 人工核验;菱形 = 用户授权判断。反馈闭环:轨迹复盘产出的规则与事件,回灌到下一次会话的热记忆。

readme.section: ① 启动热记忆 — 每个会话一次的有界上下文
readme.text:
**做什么**：新会话开始时，把「此刻最该知道的记忆」压缩成一个 ≤14KB 热包一次注入，让 Agent 不读全库也能带着上下文开工。

**包含**：机械门禁状态（缺口/锁/同步）、指令预算审计、用户画像、活跃核心规则（按 ⭐ 与引用计数筛选）、当前项目摘要（按 cwd 祖先匹配）、最近事件主标题（14 天回溯、单条 ≤180B）。

**怎么用**：`memory_bootstrap` 工具，或 `python vault-guard/bootstrap.py --cwd <项目目录> --max-bytes 14000`。推荐插件形态通过原生 `agent/pre-step` 在每个 session 首轮自动执行；手动 hooks 仅用于 standalone 兼容模式。

readme.section: ② 工作路径 — 按规则执行任务（方法论层，无脚本）
readme.text:
**做什么**：这是「Agent 怎么干活」的约定，不是脚本——热包注入后，Agent 按优先级与权限边界执行：系统/用户指令 > 项目 AGENTS.md > 全局规则 > 冷文档；技能路由（点名 → 速查表 → 图谱兜底）；最小修改、根因调查；交付前验证（语法/配置/真实运行/界面证据）。

**为什么没有脚本**：这一层是行为规范，由 `AGENTS.md` 承载。开源版提供 `templates/` 里的示例规则作为起点，使用者按自己的团队文化改写。

readme.section: ③ 冷层按需读取 — 需要细节才打开
readme.text:
**做什么**：热包只有摘要，需要细节时再检索规则、事件与项目等来源；返回有预算的证据片段。raw 默认不包含，须显式开启；不要将片段当作完整文件。

**触发**：双门槛——同时满足「历史/上次/纠正等召回信号」+「可检索的具体主题」才触发；纯确认语、复测元指令不打开。

**怎么用**：`memory_recall` 工具，或 `python vault-guard/recall.py --query "<问题>" --cwd <目录> --force`。exact + 中文 bigram BM25 + 元数据重排，输出 ≤4.2KB 冷包并附来源与 trace。

readme.section: ④ 授权写入 — 有持久价值且用户同意才写
readme.text:
**做什么**：只有「实质产出」（代码/文档变更、持久决策、用户偏好、数据口径、验收标准、下次仍需遵守的约定）且用户同意归档时，才走事务写入：拿租约锁 → 写 raw（只记事实不评价）→ 提炼归位（events/项目/rules/toolmap）→ 释放锁。

**安全机制**：30s 租约 + 5s 心跳单写者锁、before-image + SHA-256 前置 + manifest + receipt 多文件事务、raw 机械只追加（纠错必须 supersedes）、默认 dry-run、`tools/pre-execute` 强制确认。

**怎么用**：`memory_write` 工具（`op=raw/replace/recover`，`apply=true` 才落盘）。

readme.section: ⑤ 慢维护 — 机械体检 + 人工治理
readme.text:
**做什么**：定期（或怀疑记忆库不健康时）做两件事——机械体检：raw 缺口、体量超线、rules-core 同步、写锁状态；人工治理：规则毕业、冲突仲裁、过期归位、删除确认。

**边界**：`govern.py` 只收集证据与建议（重复/冲突/过期/体量/生命周期候选），**永不自动删改**；晋升/归档/删除永远需要人确认。

**怎么用**：`memory_govern` 工具，或 `python vault-guard/govern.py --json --max-items 100`。配合 `check.py` 的收尾门禁（`--closing` / `--closing --expect-write`）使用。

readme.section: ⑥ 轨迹复盘 — 证据驱动的质量反馈闭环
readme.text:
**做什么**：收尾时回溯会话轨迹，找三类点：错误（用户纠正 = 硬信号；AI 自评有自我辩护倾向）、error（仅频繁时写）、可借鉴。产出按「场景 → 错误 → 根因 → 先决动作」四字段模板的复盘候选。

**复盘四要素（缺一不算做完）**：①工具账本复盘（定量先行——`tool-telemetry.json` 各工具调用次数/错误次数/错误率/加权成本，与上轮快照做差值）；②错误复盘（定性——用户纠正硬信号/error/可借鉴，四字段模板）；③优化方案 + 派发询问；④会话临时文件清理。

**账本双口径**：快照必须记全局 + 工作区双口径——工作区口径须含 unknown 占比，unknown 异常高 = 归属失效信号，差值不可比时改全局口径。

**证据来源**：session 日志中的用户纠正信号 + `evidence-ledger` 插件的工具调用账本（谁的工具最常出错）。账本只作线索，不自动判错。

readme.section: ⑥ 轨迹复盘 — 证据驱动的质量反馈闭环
readme.text:
**闭环**：复盘出候选 → 给出降低工具错误率的方案 → 派发解决（单一任务 → 独立子 agent；优化点多 → 多 agent 团队按角色分工，依赖三问/文件所有权/交付即验收）→ 解决完成后解析会话轨迹写入 events；用户说「下次再处理」→ 跳过解决、直接写入 events。人工核验后，普通探索失败不沉淀；重复 ≥3 次的模式毕业进 rules-core——规则与事件回灌到下一次会话的热记忆，形成进化闭环。

**怎么用**：`memory_trajectory_review` 工具，或 `python vault-guard/trajectory-review.py --cwd <目录>`。配套安装 `plugins/evidence-ledger/` 才有工具账本数据；多 agent 派发执行件见 `plugins/agent-teams/`（基于 [NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams) 的增强 fork）。

</details>

readme.section: dsh-memory-system
readme.text:
**Help DeepSeek Harness find the project decisions you approved next time—with memory stored in inspectable, backup-friendly local Markdown.**

[简体中文](README.md) · [First memory](#see-a-local-round-trip-first) · [Install](#connect-to-deepseek-harness) · [Safety and limits](#safety-and-limits) · [Contribute](CONTRIBUTING.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system)

readme.section: dsh-memory-system
readme.text: Avoid repeating the same project decisions without putting your entire archive into every conversation. Load a bounded summary at startup, retrieve details when needed, and inspect the sources. Chinese keyword and bigram BM25 retrieval needs no vector database or additional model API.

readme.section: dsh-memory-system
readme.text:
- **Inspect what was remembered:** ordinary Markdown sources, with file/line citations and retrieval reasons.
- **Choose what gets saved:** plugin writes preview first and require confirmation to apply; governance proposes rather than silently edits.
- **Keep a correction trail:** this source version supports an effective view of explicitly corrected/revoked raw records while retaining history. It does not infer every contradiction.

readme.section: dsh-memory-system
readme.text: **For:** individual and small-team DSH users working with Chinese project material who want to review their memories. **Not for:** multi-tenant access isolation, high-frequency concurrent writers, or guaranteed semantic understanding. Standalone Python retrieval also works without DSH or Obsidian.

readme.section: dsh-memory-system
readme.text: > **Version scope:** this page describes its source branch. The version in the source `package.json` does not establish that the version has been published; check the [npm registry](https://registry.npmjs.org/@zhujunpeng12%2Fdsh-memory-system) for published versions and `latest`. The first-memory demo, effective raw view and retrieval evaluation require a source checkout containing the relevant files. The GitHub install command below follows the repository default branch and **does not guarantee these improvements**.

readme.section: See a local round trip first
readme.text:
Already have this source branch? Run from the repository root with Python 3.10+ (`python3` on some systems):

```sh
python vault-guard/demo_memory.py --lang en
```

The demo uses **synthetic Chinese data in a separate temporary Vault**, not your real memories. Separate writer and reader processes demonstrate:

readme.section: See a local round trip first
readme.text:
1. Persist a synthetic decision to temporary Markdown, then read it from a fresh process. The demo directly authorizes synthetic writes; it does not demonstrate host approval.
2. Default recall excludes raw records; explicitly enabling raw reveals the saved record.
3. An explicit correction leaves the new value in the effective view; audit history still exposes both records.

Excerpt from the generated output (full transcript in the walkthrough):

readme.section: See a local round trip first
readme.text:
```text
1. Remembered raw fact: 演示项目的发布检查使用蓝色清单。
5. Effective raw recall: 演示项目的发布检查改为绿色清单。 (old fact excluded)
6. History: superseded = 演示项目的发布检查使用蓝色清单。
```

This is a reproducible local Python-engine demo, **not a verified DSH new-session or approval-dialog recording**. See [first-memory walkthrough](docs/first-memory-demo.en.md) for commands, actual output and cleanup behavior.

readme.section: See a local round trip first
readme.text:
| Your goal | Start here |
| --- | --- |
| Check persistence and subsequent retrieval | Temporary-Vault demo above |
| Use memory tools inside DSH | Plugin setup below |
| Use local scripts without the host | [Standalone scripts and configuration](#standalone-scripts-and-configuration) |
| Understand corrections, old evidence and audit mode | [Raw lifecycle design](docs/raw-lifecycle-design.md) |

readme.section: Connect to DeepSeek Harness
readme.text:
Documented compatibility baseline: DSH `0.1.0-rc.7`, Node.js 22/24, Python 3.10+. This is not a compatibility promise for other host versions. See [troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

```sh

readme.section: Installs the repository default branch, not a pinned snapshot of this feature branch
readme.text:
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system
```

Restart Harness and ask the agent to run `memory_gate`. First use creates an empty Vault skeleton; **it does not invent personal memories**. The native `agent/pre-step` hook injects a `[vault-bootstrap]` packet on the first step of each session. No manual hooks setup is needed; `DSH_MEMORY_AUTO_INJECT=false` disables automatic injection.

readme.section: Installs the repository default branch, not a pinned snapshot of this feature branch
readme.text:
To try **this source branch**, package that checkout from its repository root, then install locally:sh
npm pack
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add ./zhujunpeng12-dsh-memory-system-0.1.1.tgz
```

The `0.1.1.tgz` filename comes from the source version and does not by itself establish the npm publication status. Check for `vault-guard/demo_memory.py` and `vault-guard/raw_lifecycle.py` before packing. Engine tests do not replace installation verification in your target DSH environment.

readme.section: Installs the repository default branch, not a pinned snapshot of this feature branch
readme.text: For the first real memory, ask the agent to preview `memory_write`, inspect the content and path, then confirm the call with `apply=true`. Check the receipt and source file afterward: an agent saying “remembered” is not persistence evidence. Raw records do not automatically become hot summaries; explicitly use `memory_recall` with `includeRaw=true` when needed, or separately approve a curated project/rule note.

readme.section: Tools and data flow
readme.text:
| Tool | Purpose | Write boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memory_bootstrap` | Bounded hot context, default ≤14KB | Reads memories |
| `memory_recall` | Chinese keyword retrieval, default packet ≤4.2KB, sources and trace | Reads memories; index is rebuildable derived data |
| `memory_gate` | Mechanical health checks | Does not edit memory bodies |
| `memory_govern` | Duplicate, conflict and expiry candidates | No automatic edits/deletions |
| `memory_trajectory_review` | Review candidates from session evidence | No automatic archival |
| `memory_write` | Raw append, replace and recovery | Dry-run by default; applied plugin writes require confirmation |

readme.section: Tools and data flow
readme.text: Markdown is the source of truth; the index is not a second authoritative memory. Node connects to the host; Python's standard library handles local storage and retrieval. Optional `plugins/evidence-ledger/` supplies a local tool ledger; without it, review uses correction signals in session logs only. The companion `plugins/agent-teams/` is not required for first use.

readme.section: Standalone scripts and configuration
readme.text:
| Environment variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MEMORY_VAULT` | `~/.dsh-memory` | Memory root directory |
| `DSH_HOME` | `~/.dsh` | Host session/runtime storage |

For standalone use, prepare a Vault using [templates/README.md](templates/README.md). Run these commands from the repository root; they read your configured Vault, **not** the demo's temporary Vault:

readme.section: Standalone scripts and configuration
readme.text:
```sh
python vault-guard/bootstrap.py --cwd . --max-bytes 14000
python vault-guard/recall.py --query "上次的备份约定" --cwd . --force

readme.section: This source version: effective raw view; add --include-history for an audit
readme.text:
python vault-guard/recall.py --query "备份约定" --force --include-raw
```

Obsidian is an optional viewer. You may point `MEMORY_VAULT` at an existing Vault; back it up before configuring templates. Legacy standalone hooks are documented in [hooks.example.json](hooks.example.json); plugin users do not need them.

readme.section: Safety and limits
readme.text:
- **Local storage does not mean content never leaves your device.** The engine needs no external model service, but the plugin passes selected memories into host context. Your host, model and logging services have their own data policies. Do not store secrets unsuitable for model input.
- **Retrieved content is data, not authority.** Imported Markdown, recalled snippets and session evidence may contain malicious instructions. They do not authorize commands or writes. This project does not guarantee prompt-injection filtering; retain host permission boundaries and review sources.
- **Approval and recovery are not infallible.** Applied plugin writes use `tools/pre-execute` confirmation; CLI users are responsible for `--apply`. Single-writer locks, precondition hashes and transaction receipts reduce risk, not the need for backups or filesystem permissions. Do not clear locks/transaction records you do not understand.
- **Project context is ranking, not isolation.** A shared Vault can return other projects' evidence; Git branches in the same directory are not isolated. Use separate Vaults and appropriate permissions for sensitive projects.
- **Retrieval is not semantic understanding.**

readme.section: Verify and contribute
readme.text:
From the repository root:

```sh
npm run check
python vault-guard/eval_recall.py
```

Regression tests use temporary data. Retrieval evaluation contains only **10 original synthetic cases**, not real-user accuracy measurements. It deliberately retains a paraphrase miss and a stale curated-summary case. See [metric definitions and revision comparisons](docs/recall-evaluation.md). Latency is informational, not a performance guarantee.

readme.section: Verify and contribute
readme.text: Start with [troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md); report versions, commands and sanitized errors, not private memories or keys. [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [24-source README design review](docs/readme-design-review.md).

readme.section: Under the hood
readme.text:
The following is a conceptual architecture diagram and responsibility guide, **not a product screenshot or evidence of runtime results**.

<details>
<summary>Expand the six-layer architecture and implementation guide</summary>

readme.section: System architecture (six-layer closed loop)
readme.text:
Maintainable source: [HTML/CSS V3 diagram](docs/memory-system-flowchart.html).
Expand for the editable Mermaid diagram synchronized with V3 ```mermaid flowchart TD Start([New session / task]) --> Bundle["@zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system
scoped bundle · inject tools + agents"] Bundle --> Roots[Register 6 tools per root agent
bootstrap · recall · gate · govern · trajectory · write]

readme.section: System architecture (six-layer closed loop)
readme.text:
Legend: solid = scripted execution; dashed = on-demand read / human review; diamond = user authorization decision. The feedback loop distills rules and events back into the next session's hot memory.

</details>

readme.section: ① Hot-memory bootstrap — one bounded context per session
readme.text:
**What**: at session start, compress "what the agent most needs to know right now" into one ≤14KB packet and inject it once. No full-vault reads to get started.

**Contents**: mechanical gate status (gaps/lock/sync), instruction-budget audit, user profile, active core rules (star + citation filtered), current project summary (cwd-ancestor match), recent event headings (14-day lookback, ≤180B each).

readme.section: ① Hot-memory bootstrap — one bounded context per session
readme.text: **How**: `memory_bootstrap` tool, or `python vault-guard/bootstrap.py --cwd <dir> --max-bytes 14000`. The recommended plugin uses native `agent/pre-step` on the first turn of every session; manual hooks are only for standalone compatibility.

readme.section: ② Working path — rules-driven execution (methodology, no script)
readme.text:
**What**: how the agent works, not a script: priority & permission boundaries (system/user > project AGENTS.md > global rules > cold docs), skill routing (named → index table → graph fallback), minimal edits, root-cause investigation, verified delivery (syntax/config/real-run/UI evidence).

**Why no script**: this layer is behavioral policy carried by `AGENTS.md`. The repo ships `templates/` with example rules as a starting point.

readme.section: ③ Cold layer on demand — open details only when needed
readme.text:
**What**: when a task needs evidence or details, cold recall searches rule, event and project sources and returns bounded evidence snippets with citations—not complete files. Raw records are excluded unless explicitly enabled. Do not assume that all historical or session material is searched.

**Trigger**: two gates — a recall signal (history/last time/correction) **and** a concrete searchable topic, both required. Plain acknowledgements or meta-only follow-ups do not open cold memory.

readme.section: ③ Cold layer on demand — open details only when needed
readme.text: **How**: `memory_recall` tool, or `python vault-guard/recall.py --query "<q>" --cwd <dir> --force`. Exact + Chinese bigram BM25 + metadata rerank, ≤4.2KB packet with sources and trace.

readme.section: ④ Authorized writes — write only when persistent value + user consent
readme.text: **What**: only "substantive output" (code/doc changes, persistent decisions, user preferences, data conventions, acceptance criteria, standing agreements) with explicit user consent goes through the transactional writer: acquire lease lock → append raw (facts only) → distill into events/projects/rules → release lock.

readme.section: ④ Authorized writes — write only when persistent value + user consent
readme.text:
**Safety**: 30s lease + 5s heartbeat single-writer lock; before-image + SHA-256 precondition + manifest + receipt multi-file transactions; raw append-only (corrections require supersedes); dry-run by default; `tools/pre-execute` confirmation enforced.

**How**: `memory_write` tool (`op=raw/replace/recover`, applies only with `apply=true`).

readme.section: ⑤ Slow maintenance — mechanical health checks + human governance
readme.text:
**What**: periodically (or when the vault feels unhealthy): mechanical checks (raw gaps, size limits, rules-core sync, lock state) and human governance (rule graduation, conflict arbitration, expiry archiving, deletion confirmation).

**Boundary**: `govern.py` collects evidence and suggestions only (duplicates/conflicts/staleness/size/lifecycle candidates), **never auto-deletes**. Promotion/archive/deletion always requires a human.

readme.section: ⑤ Slow maintenance — mechanical health checks + human governance
readme.text: **How**: `memory_govern` tool, or `python vault-guard/govern.py --json --max-items 100`. Pair with `check.py` closing gates (`--closing` / `--closing --expect-write`).

readme.section: ⑥ Trajectory review — evidence-driven quality feedback loop
readme.text: **What**: at wrap-up, scan the session trace for three kinds of items: errors (user corrections = hard signal; AI self-review is self-serving), repeated tool errors (only when frequent), and reusable lessons. Output candidates in the four-field template: scenario → error → root cause → precondition.

readme.section: ⑥ Trajectory review — evidence-driven quality feedback loop
readme.text: **Four required parts (a review is incomplete without all four)**: ① ledger review (quantitative first — per-tool call counts / error rates / weighted cost from `tool-telemetry.json`, diffed against the previous snapshot); ② error review (qualitative — user corrections as hard signal / errors / reusable lessons, four-field template); ③ improvement plan + dispatch question; ④ session temp-file cleanup.

readme.section: ⑥ Trajectory review — evidence-driven quality feedback loop
readme.text:
**Dual-scope ledger snapshot**: snapshots must record both global and per-workspace scopes — the workspace scope must include its unknown share; an abnormally high unknown share signals broken attribution, in which case fall back to the global scope for comparisons.

**Evidence**: user-correction signals from session logs + the tool-call ledger from the `evidence-ledger` plugin (which tools fail most). The ledger is a clue, never an automatic verdict.

readme.section: ⑥ Trajectory review — evidence-driven quality feedback loop
readme.text: **Loop**: review produces candidates → propose a plan to lower tool error rates → dispatch the fix (single task → independent sub-agent; multiple improvements → a multi-agent team split by role, using the dependency triple-check / file ownership / accept-on-delivery discipline) → after the fixes land, distill the session trace into events; if the user says "next time", skip the fix and distill directly. After human review, ordinary exploration failures are not distilled; patterns repeating ≥3 times graduate into rules-core — rules and events feed back into the next session's hot memory.

readme.section: ⑥ Trajectory review — evidence-driven quality feedback loop
readme.text:
**How**: `memory_trajectory_review` tool, or `python vault-guard/trajectory-review.py --cwd <dir>`. Install `plugins/evidence-ledger/` for ledger data.

</details>
